issues: Frame 4 leaves the entire eye band blank, briefly weakening the rotational landmark and making the middle of the spin feel visually dead.

issues: Frames 3-5 reduce the eyes to edge fragments and then none in frame 4, so the rear-facing phase can briefly resemble blinking rather than rotation when viewed frame-by-frame.

fixes: No essential correction is needed; the stable silhouette and economical eye-band occlusion are authentically NES-like.
